definition: a pot-bellied man.
example_en: The pot-bellied man tied a tight belt around his waist.

definition: not moving; very firmly.
example: ಆ ಮರದ ಬುಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲ್ಲು ವಿನಿಶ್ಚಳಂ ಆಗಿ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: At the base of that tree the stone stood very firmly without moving.

definition: an apparatus for receiving or transmitting radio broadcasts; a radio.
example_en: Grandfather listens to the news on the radio every day.

definition: the food of gods; ambrosia.
example_en: Ambrosia was obtained from the churning of the ocean.

definition: a sequence of photographs or drawings, having a theme, story, etc., projected on a screen in such rapid succession that they create the optical illusion (because of the persistence of vision) of moving persons and objects; a film; a cinema.
example_en: That film became popular everywhere.

definition: he who prohibits or has authority to prohibit.
example_en: That officer was the one who prohibited this activity.

definition: a largge sailing vessel.
example_en: The large sailing vessel was unloading goods at the harbour.

definition: an envious man.
example: ಕರುಂಬನಾದ ಅವನು ಯಾರ ಪ್ರಗತಿಯನ್ನೂ ನೋಡಲು ಇಷ್ಟಪಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.

definition: a vessel or a hallow place in the ground for preserving sacrificial fire or a hollow in the ground for the purpose of preservng ordinary house-hold fire.
example_en: The fire priests kept the sacred fire in the fire vessel.

definition: the celestial river Gaŋgā.
example: ಆಗಸದೊಱೆ ಭೂಮಿಗೆ ಇಳಿದು ಬಂದಿತೆಂದು ಪುರಾಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The purāṇa says the celestial river Gaŋgā descended to earth.

definition: to check or stop (another's movement) on the way; to obstruct.

definition: the act or process of moving.
example_en: The farmers' movement spread across the state.

definition: a glassy, coloured, opaque coating fused to surfaces of metals, glass, and pottery as an ornamental or protective coating; enamel.

definition: cheapness of price.

example_en: This year the cheapness of rice price brought loss to the farmers.

definition: the life of a lewd, lecherous person.
example_en: His lecherous way of life disgusted the villagers.

definition: a fat, corpulent man.
example: ಆ ತುಂಡಾಡಿಗ ಊಟದ ನಂತರ ಗೊರಕೆ ಹೊಡೆಯುತ್ತಾ ಮಲಗಿದನು.
example_en: That corpulent man lay down snoring after the meal.

definition: to change (something) or make alterations so that it fits, corresponds or conforms; to adjust.
example: ಅವನು ಹೊಸ ನಿಯಮಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಪದಗೆಯ್ದನು.

definition: the act or fact of betrothing or being betrothed; betrothal; engagement.

definition: to cause to fill the entire area or to become spread over a wide area.

definition: (fig.) refuting or disproving speech.

definition: a very young child.
example_en: The very young child was crying from hunger.

definition: a very vast sea.
example: ನಾವಿಕರು ಹೆಗ್ಗಡಲನ್ನು ದಾಟಿ ದೂರದ ದ್ವೀಪ ತಲುಪಿದರು.
example_en: The sailors crossed the vast sea and reached the distant island.

definition: a tall spar or, now often, a hollow metal structure, sometimes in sections, rising vertically from the keel or deck of a vessel and used to support the sails, yards, radar and radio equipment, etc.; the mast of a vessel.
example_en: The ship's mast bent in the storm.

definition: bright-red mercuric sulphide used as a pigment; vermilion.

definition: a part of the body of a plant that develops, typically, from the radicle and grows downward into the soil, anchoring the plant and drawing water and nourishment from the soil and stores food; a root.
example_en: The plant's root has gone deep into the soil.

definition: too numerous to be counted; very many; countless; innumerable.
example_en: Countless people live in that country.

definition: determined by and emphasising the features and characteristics of the object or thing dealt with, rather than by the thoughts, feelings and prejudices of the artist, writer or speakerl objective; without prejudice; detached.
example_en: The journalist wrote an objective report.

definition: an extent of level land; plain.
example_en: They were growing crops on that vast plain.

definition: a small glass container holding writing ink; an ink-pot.

definition: a long stick of standard length, marked with subdivisions, used for measuring; a yardstick.

example_en: The youth were inspired by the idealistic theory.

definition: to be free from worry, trouble, agitation, etc.

definition: a straight, slender stem, that does not have twigs or leaves.
example_en: A dry, leafless stem stood in the garden.

definition: the act of crossing over from one side to the other or going out of a situation, condition.
example_en: The crossing over from one state to another took place.

definition: an unfounded saying, statement, accusation, etc.

definition: (pl.) all the spices.
example_en: All the spices were arranged in the shop.

definition: to face bravely; to confront boldly.

definition: to put forth branches; to branch.

definition: to set oneself against; to resist, argue against or be hostile to; to oppose.

definition: bearing; holding; carrying; supporting.

definition: to hang down loosely, losing firmness, strength, etc.

definition: a hand tool for turning screws, consisting of a handle attached to a long, narrow shank, usu. of metal, which tapers and flattens out to a tip that fits into the slot in the head of the screw; a screw driver.
example_en: He tightened the screw with the screwdriver.

definition: a decision taken after a careful deliberation.
example_en: They announced the decision reached after the meeting's careful deliberation.

definition: skill in using one's mind; cleverness.
example_en: Thanks to his cleverness the problem was solved quickly.

definition: to plan or contrive secretly (a crime, conspiracy, etc.); to plot.
example_en: They gathered at night and plotted secretly.

definition: a goldsmith's work, profession; goldsmithy.

definition: a native provincial deputy or governor of the old Mogul Empire; a nawab.

definition: to lean on.
example_en: The tired traveller sat leaning against the wall.

definition: a searching look.
example: ಅವಳ ಹುಡುಕುನೋಟ ಕೋಣೆಯ ಮೂಲೆ ಮೂಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತಾಡಿತು.

definition: a large group of musicians playing various musical instruments together; an orchestra.

definition: a blow with the foot; a kick.

definition: the quality or state of being unmanageable.
example_en: The child's unmanageable nature brought worry to the parents.

definition: the quality of a base, wicked or evil person.

definition: the chief of an army.

definition: to give a share or portion (of something) to.

definition: an extent of level land; plain.

definition: the condition of being naked; nakedness.

definition: heat; warmth.
example_en: Today there is a lot of heat.

definition: the part of milk, curds etc. that floats on the liquid part of the same; cream.

definition: a particular game of chance played with stakes.

definition: an advising with evil or wicked ideas.

definition: to draw a line.
example_en: The teacher drew a line on the board.

definition: to put a step forward.

definition: manifestation a soul in a physical, esp. a human, form.

definition: forward and backward.

definition: to promise or pledge by placing one's palm on another's.

definition: that can be seen.

definition: the quality or fact of moving, acting with a great speed; swiftness; quickness.

definition: to bring together; to cause to assemble; to collect; to congregate.

definition: an eye that resembles a flower or the petal of a flower; a beautiful eye.

definition: without use; uselessly; fruitlessly; futilely.

definition: (gram.) a word that is in masculine gender.

definition: that which is kept as an aim; purpose.

definition: he who is omnipresent, omnipotent and perfect.

definition: the plant Elaegnus latifolia of Elaeagnaceae family; bastard oleaster plant.

definition: a composition, as of lime or gypsum, sand, water, etc., for applying on to walls, ceilings, etc.to give a smooth finishing; plaster.

definition: the opening through which an animal or human takes in food; the mouth.

definition: a portable, domestic charcoal furnace.

definition: a stick made of a kind of rattan.

definition: sandal powder paste.

definition: an affectionate, loving person.

definition: elegance of words; a graceful style.

definition: dirt; dust; filth.

definition: a large kettle-drum.

definition: jumped, leaped upward.

definition: the act of offering something to a god through fire; oblation.

definition: the tender cheek or chin (of or as of a child).

definition: a cheating or being cheated; deception.

definition: prejudice of a witness towards the cause.

definition: an apparatus, utensil or stove for cooking, using the pressure of the steam; a cooker.

definition: a kind of plant with bulbous roots.

definition: a state of mental distress; worry.

definition: the act of protecting, guarding; protection.

definition: the total amount; aggregate; sum.

definition: one who conveys in a boat; a boat's man; a boater.

definition: extreme pain.

definition: a region, place of this side.

definition: the act or practice of observing or keeping a custom, religious regulation, etc.; observance.
example_en: The devotees observed the vow's practice with devotion.

definition: to cause to become (uncomfortably) cold; to make (something) frigid.
example_en: The winter wind made his hands cold.

definition: the part of the central nervous system enclosed in the cranium of humans and other vertebrates, consisting of a soft, convoluted mass of gray and white matter and serving to control and coordinate the mental and physical actions; the brain.
example_en: The doctor conducted an examination of the brain.

definition: an amount of money charged for exchanging a foreign currency.
example_en: One had to pay a foreign exchange fee at the bank to exchange dollars.

definition: a silvery, lightweight, easily worked, metallic chemical element that resists corrosion, used for making vessels, wires, etc.; aluminium.
example_en: These vessels are made from aluminium.

definition: to inflict damage, injury or punishment in return for (an injury, insult, etc.); retaliate for; to revenge.
example_en: The army got ready to take revenge on the enemies.

definition: the vaporous matter arising from something burning and made visible by minute particles of carbon suspended in it; smoke.
example: ಒಲೆಯಿಂದ ಎದ್ದ ಪೊಗೆ ಮನೆಯ ತುಂಬಾ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The smoke rising from the stove spread through the house.

definition: to become dark or black.
example_en: The sky was becoming dark.

definition: to cause to bite.
example_en: He made the dog bite the child.

definition: an airtight bag that rises and floats above the earth when filled with air (sometime with hot air or a gas lighter than air, such as hydrogen or helium; a balloon.
example_en: They had decorated the wedding hall with balloons.

definition: to urge on; to spur on; to incite; to instigate.
example_en: The leaders incited the people to struggle.

definition: the act or process of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth; vomiting.
example: ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವನೆಯ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಛರ್ದಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: He vomited after eating food.

definition: the quality of a stupid person; stupidity.
example_en: Everyone knew of his stupidity.

definition: to carry on a trade or business; to trade.
example_en: He was carrying on a big business in the town.

definition: (pl.) two sides (of the same thing).
example: ಕನ್ನಡಿಯ ಇಮ್ಮೆಯ್ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The two sides of the mirror served different uses.

definition: the state of being liberated (from the arbitrary control of another); liberation.
example: ಸಾಧಕರು ಜೀವನದ ಗುರಿ ಮುಕ್ತಿ ಎಂದು ನಂಬುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Seekers believe that the goal of life is liberation.

definition: the quality of being or the state that makes one distinct or superior; distinction; superiority.
example_en: His superiority spread throughout the town.

definition: to perform or exhibit a play.
example_en: The artists performed a play at the village fair.

definition: soft; tender.
example_en: This blanket is very soft and tender.

definition: the family of agriculturists who get their land tilled and cultivation done from paid servants.
example: ದಾರೊಕ್ಕಲು ಕುಟುಂಬವು ತನ್ನ ಜಮೀನನ್ನು ಆಳುಗಳಿಂದ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The agricultural family gets its land tilled by hired servants.

definition: the act, fact or an instance of advocating or speaking or writing in support of both the rival parties.
example_en: The lawyer's arguing for both sides confused the judges.

definition: the blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: The flower was drenched in the morning dew.

definition: a vegetable, fruit or a combination of them, preserved in vinegar or spicy solution, and served to add taste or as an appetising relish; a pickle.
example_en: Mother prepared mango pickle.

definition: a strong, unpleasant, offensive smell; stink; stench.
example_en: A foul stench was coming from the rotten fish.

definition: to become a servant, slave.
example_en: Unable to repay the debt, he became a slave.

definition: (a nauseating, sickening feeling) to occur.
example_en: That smell made me feel nauseated.

definition: a place where ships load or unload; a port.
example_en: The ships unloaded cargo at the port.

definition: several times; repeating or recurring more than once.
example_en: He has travelled along this road several times.

definition: to hold fast; to cling to.
example_en: The crying child clung fast to its mother's sari end.

definition: to be blamed, accused.
example_en: He was blamed even though he was without fault.
